memories.content: Link each HCI research question directly to corresponding user data and analysis procedures.
In preregistered studies, specify the conditions under which deviations from the plan are permissible.
In preregistered studies, specify how to record content that deviates from the plan.
Commit to one exact target number of participants so the schedule, workload, and budget can be checked against the same quantity.
Specify the interview protocols, recording devices, or log tools used to collect each type of user data.
Specify whether each type of user data is collected before, during, or after the interaction.
Readers cannot tell whether the schedule and budget agree when different sections imply different target counts.
In formative evaluation prototypes, implementation instability exists as an independent cause of task failure alongside design choices.
If a prototype safety signal occurs during formative evaluation, existing institutional safety procedures take precedence over planned data collection.
Reviewers judge answerability by tracing the path from each research question to the data and analysis.
The author of this proposal tends to present implemented feature lists directly as design contributions.
Calculate the required sessions, facilitator hours, and participant payments from the same exact target rather than from separate rough estimates.
If recruitment falls below the exact target, state the shortfall explicitly and revise the affected schedule or deliverable.
Do not use a wide range merely to postpone choosing the quantity that the rest of the proposal must support.
Do not change names referring to the same user roles, system functions, or operational stages midway.
Use abbreviations only for long recurring terms in a two-page proposal.
Present the full term and abbreviation together when using an abbreviation for the first time.
Refer to participants based on the roles they perform in the study rather than their status.
Reviewers from different subfields find it difficult to infer an abbreviation from context alone when it is not defined at first use.
When introducing an operational role for the first time, define both the decisions it can make and the actions it performs.
Individuals holding identical job titles may possess different system modification privileges and data access rights depending on their deployment site.
The user tends to group distinct field roles under the single label “user.”

analysis.overview: The frames are complementary but substantively separate: the reference focuses on study traceability, preregistration, data collection, participant planning, prototype risk, and contribution framing, while the compared frame focuses on terminology, abbreviations, and precise operational-role descriptions. Neither supplies a scope-aligned counterpart to the other.

relations.reason: These reference memories state and explain one traceability requirement, with no corresponding claim in the compared frame.
relations.summary: Research-question answerability depends on directly tracing each question to its user data and analysis procedures.

relations.reason: The reference memories split one deviation-governance policy into authorization and recording requirements; the compared frame does not address preregistration.
relations.summary: Preregistered-study deviations require advance governance covering both permissible conditions and documentation.

relations.reason: These reference memories jointly state, motivate, and operationalize one exact-target planning policy; no compared memory governs participant quantity planning.
relations.summary: Participant planning should use one exact target consistently across schedule, workload, budget, payments, and explicit shortfall handling.

relations.reason: The reference memories split one data-collection specification requirement into method and timing; the compared frame has no counterpart.
relations.summary: Each user-data type should identify both its collection tools or protocols and its timing relative to interaction.

relations.reason: This is a one-sided causal interpretation for prototype task failures, distinct from the compared frame’s terminology policies.
relations.summary: Formative evaluation should treat prototype implementation instability as a failure cause independent of design choices.

relations.reason: This is a one-sided safety-priority rule with no scope-aligned claim in the compared frame.
relations.summary: A formative-prototype safety signal makes institutional safety procedures take precedence over planned data collection.

relations.reason: This is a one-sided observation about contribution framing and is not addressed by the compared frame.
relations.summary: The proposal author tends to present implemented feature lists directly as design contributions.

relations.reason: This compared-only policy governs renaming the same concepts, independently of the reference frame’s study-design requirements.
relations.summary: Names for the same roles, functions, and operational stages should remain consistent throughout a proposal.

relations.reason: These compared memories jointly provide selection, introduction, and reader-impact aspects of one abbreviation policy; the reference frame has no counterpart.
relations.summary: A short proposal should reserve abbreviations for long recurring terms and define each at first use for cross-subfield readability.

relations.reason: The compared memories state and motivate one role-sensitive labeling policy; the reference frame does not address participant naming.
relations.summary: Participant terminology should distinguish performed field roles rather than collapse distinct people into generic or status-based labels.

relations.reason: This compared-only requirement concerns the content of role definitions, not any operational decision covered by the reference frame.
relations.summary: A newly introduced operational role should be defined by both its decision authority and its performed actions.

relations.reason: This compared-only claim warns that titles do not determine site-specific authority, a distinct issue absent from the reference frame.
relations.summary: Identical job titles can entail different modification privileges and data-access rights across deployment sites.

reports.compared_only: The compared frame promotes stable terminology, selective and defined abbreviations, role-based participant labels, explicit role authority and actions, and recognition of site-dependent privileges.
reports.reference_only: The reference specifies research traceability, deviation governance, collection methods and timing, exact participant planning, prototype failure and safety handling, and a contribution-framing concern.
